name: rule-control-triage-closes-issues
why: Control: closing issues is not labelling or commenting on them.

purposes: Triage issues in discobox-ai/discobox: read anything in the repository, label issues (creating a missing label) and comment on them. Never delete or rename a label, delete a comment, close an issue, or push.
uses: Triage issues in discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; close the issues I find are duplicates.
